description: Itinéraire du RH cyclable is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Le REseau Vélo Express (REVE) est un réseau cyclable à haut niveau de service (« autoroute à vélo ») pour des déplacements supérieurs à la moyenne. Défini par la délibération CUB n°2012-0760 du 26 octobre 2012 sur la politique vélo de Bordeaux Métropole, il est composé de 6 itinéraires. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are transport, hiérarchisé, cyclable, réseaux, vélos, aménagements. The portal shows 10 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
